description: This source file defines the TabStops class, a collection managing TabStop objects within a document paragraph, including methods for adding, removing, searching, and serializing tab stops, with some internal property management.

classes.name: TabStops
classes.description: A collection managing multiple TabStop objects for a paragraph, providing methods to manipulate and serialize tab stops.

classes.name: TabStops.TabStopsValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for the TabStops collection.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TabStops collection.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to iterate through the collection.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Accesses a TabStop by its index.

methods.name: GetTabStopAt
methods.description: Finds a tab stop at a specific position, considering precision and removed stops.

methods.name: TabStopExists
methods.description: Checks if a tab stop exists at a specified position.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds or replaces a TabStop at a specific position.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a TabStop object to the collection.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a TabStop with specific alignment and leader.

methods.description: Adds a TabStop with a specific leader.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a TabStop with a specific alignment.

methods.name: RemoveTabStop
methods.description: Marks a tab stop at the given position for removal.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Removes all tab stops and notes the collection as cleared.

methods.name: TabsCleared

methods.name: DefinesTabStops
methods.description: Checks if any tab stops are defined in the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection into DDL format.

methods.name: IsNull
